verdict.rationale: Docusign ships AI features (Iris, AI-Assisted Review, summaries), so a training opt-out is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents an opt-out, a no-training commitment, or any data-use control for model training. The applicable axis is therefore unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
